content.text:
This page is already a solid, well-built starter template — good a11y (skip link, aria-current scrollspy, focus-visible), SEO/meta tags, dark mode, responsive CSS, and a working nav. Since it's just placeholder content, "improve" could mean different things. What are you going for?

- Replace placeholder content (title, description, email, URLs) with real info?
- Add features (more sections, a working contact form, dark/light toggle button, mobile hamburger menu)?
- Polish visuals (better typography/spacing, add a hero image, color theme)?
- Technical hardening (structured data accuracy, performance, add analytics, form validation)?

Let me know the direction and I'll make the changes.
